expected_observable_behavior.zh: 伸出时间持续上升；第21天部分维修后下降但未回到初始水平。
expected_observable_behavior.en: Extension time rises; after partial repair on day 21 it drops but not back to the initial level.

expected_health_response.zh: 维修前 WARNING；维修后 WATCH（部分改善）；影响分析报告部分恢复。
expected_health_response.en: WARNING before repair; WATCH after (partial improvement); impact analysis reports partial recovery.

abstention_cases.zh: 维护后稳定期内不做健康结论（UNKNOWN）。
abstention_cases.en: No health conclusion during post-maintenance stabilization (UNKNOWN).
